opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK; individuals must have formal employment with a UK host institution; organisations must be UK‑based; projects led by schools, undergraduates, PhD fees, or without a UK host are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Nuffield Foundation’s priority questions, with grants up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000). Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals and organisations in the UK, with a focus on applicants from racially minoritised communities and partnership projects involving such communities.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, identities, belonging, civic participation and life chances, with grants ranging from £15k to £500k.
